_comment: Copy to config.local.json (git-ignored) and keep only the keys you need. Environment variables (EDIABAS_VM_NAME, EDIABAS_VM_MAC, EDIABAS_AGENT_PORT) win over this file. vmName is the VM's name in UTM (default Windows); its MAC is read from UTM's config for that VM. Add "vmMac": "aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff" only if that lookup fails. voltageSources: extra voltage readings for ediabas_vehicle_status, as {"ecu": ..., "job": ...} entries (at most 16), e.g. {"ecu": "NVE_65", "job": "STATUS_BORDNETZSPANNUNG"} on an E60/E61 with night vision; none by default. Keys starting with _ are comments.
